query: WITH changed AS (DELETE FROM endpoint_tools WHERE endpoint_id=$1 AND (source_id,upstream_name) IN (SELECT * FROM unnest($2::uuid[],$3::text[])) RETURNING source_id,upstream_name) INSERT INTO control_changes(request_id,workspace_id,kind,item,action) SELECT $4,$1,'scope',t.path,'exclude' FROM changed c JOIN tools t ON t.source_id=c.source_id AND t.upstream_name=c.upstream_name
